title: 恶魔契约者 Demon Contract Warrior
description:
background introduction：As the protagonist of a high school student who is caught up in trouble and at a loss, a girl who claims to be a demon inexplicably appears and offers to help each other.

Thus, while balancing real life, embark on adventures in another world with companions.

Game content：This game is a storyline oriented RPG. When encountering certain troubles in reality, plan your time to solve puzzles and engage in battles in another world, and advance your exploration to obtain problem-solving items.

The game content unfolds through two lines. On the one hand, it explores the corresponding position in another world before facing great difficulties in reality.

On the other hand, it is to spend time with peers in real life, deepen bonds, and prepare supplies for the exploration of the other world through various actions.

The more preparations you make in the real world, the easier it will be to explore the other world. By preparing well and then exploring the other world, you can better utilize your time.

Game features：

• About 20 hours of game time

• The date will keep moving forward

• The things that can be done at different time periods and on different days of the week may vary slightly

• Plan time to take action

• Spending time with friends 

• Exploration and puzzle solving

• Fixed and non resurrected enemies, depending on your strategy, weak may not necessarily be unable to defeat strong

• The way skills and abilities are upgraded is different from traditional RPG games
description_short: This is a "time management" game that includes love simulation and turn based strategy battle puzzle solving, with dual development. Each girl you can meet has her own story and personality, and players can freely choose who to ultimately establish a romantic relationship with, or choose Single.
